{{Quote|By the way, it's not actually Kirdoff. Fodrick, Thaymes Fodrick. Nice to meet you.|Thaymes Fodrick to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Thaymes Fodrick''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. 

==Biography==
Thaymes Fodrick became a member of [[Sharr Latt]]'s unit of [[Wraith Squadron]] in [[44 ABY]]. He was a computer [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and he was skilled in communications duties. He first met [[Myri Antilles]], a member of [[Bhindi Drayson]]'s unit of Wraith Squadron, in a bar on [[Vandor-3]] during both units' missions to expose corrupt [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] for his involvement with the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]]. While Antilles introduced herself as Rima to Fodrick, Fodrick himself introduced as Kirdoff.<ref name="MK" />

When both Drayson and Latt's Wraith units met during their infiltration of the [[Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat|Caridan]] animal exhibit, which Thaal used to operate his criminal activities from, they integrated into a sole unit even after Drayson died during the mission. The integration of both units saw to the successful accomplishment of getting Thaal arrested on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I got well known for slicing into secure computer systems for fun. Got caught by a security consultant named Garik Loran, who shook a finger at me and let me go. Two years later, Sharr recruits me.|Thaymes Fodrick|<ref name="MK" />}}
Fodrick was a skilled slicer who became well known for breaking into secure computer systems for amusement. His slicing abilities attracted the attention of security consultant Garik Loran, who caught him but chose not to pursue further action. Two years later, Fodrick's talents led to his recruitment by Sharr Latt into Wraith Squadron.<ref name="MK" />
